# verification activity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:verificationActivity`](gmeow-verificationActivity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/verificationActivity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The verification activity performed on an attestation. Non-functional: an attestation may be verified multiple times by different verifiers.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) -> [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationActivity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:verificationActivity`](gmeow-verificationActivity.md) from [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) to [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationActivity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md), [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationActivity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link an attestation to a [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationActivity.md) that checked it — the act perspective, when you care about who ran the check and with what inputs.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the outcome of the check (use [`gmeow:verificationResult`](gmeow-verificationResult.md)) and avoid assuming one canonical check — an attestation may be verified repeatedly by different verifiers, so it is non-functional.

### How to use

- Point the [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) at each [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationActivity.md) that examined it; each activity in turn produces a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) linked via [`gmeow:verificationResult`](gmeow-verificationResult.md).

### Examples

- ex:provAtt [`gmeow:verificationActivity`](gmeow-verificationActivity.md) ex:verifyRun.
